headlines.title: NYT Cooking’s AI assistant saved my weeknight chicken, but almost ruined my cake
headlines.summary: Around 7PM each weeknight, I find myself standing in front of the fridge, trying to decide on something for dinner that won't make my husband complain, "Chicken again?" Yes, I should meal plan more, but I don't, so this is where I'm at. A nightly battle in which the chicken usually wins.

concept.title: Hallucinations & Reliability
concept.body: Models can state false things with total confidence because they optimise for plausible text, not truth. Reliability comes from grounding, verification steps, and human review.
concept.takeaway: For anything customer- or board-facing, design a checking step; never ship raw model output unverified.
